caption: The drawing depicts a single mortar and pestle set, centrally placed on a plain, light-colored background. The mortar is tall, flares outward at the top, and has a wide, thick base, and both the mortar and pestle appear to be made of wood, as suggested by the visible grain and texture. The wood is primarily brown, with variations in shading used to indicate the rough surface and irregularities, such as cracks and natural imperfections. The pestle, which is cylindrical and slightly tapers towards one end, rests at an angle inside the mortar, with the handle sticking out. The overall style is realistic with careful attention to the details of the wood grain and surface texture. There is a small, handwritten label beneath the drawing.
title: Mortar and Pestle
